sentences.text: The documents do not state a pre-payment charge for gold loans in the Gold Loan FAQ.
For loans and advances not covered by paragraph 261(1) or (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

The applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges shall be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and where KFS is to be provided, the same shall also be mentioned in the KFS.
